_comment: Claude Code hook configuration. Hooks fire automatically — no domain-specific content needed for base enforcement.
_extension_guide: Add domain-specific hooks by appending to the arrays below. Base hooks stay untouched.

PreToolUse.description: Permission gate: deny-list + phase-gate + egress. Exits 2 to BLOCK.
Blocks hardcoded secrets (API keys, tokens, passwords in code).

PostToolUse.description: Records every tool execution result to audit.log.

Stop.description: Records token usage and cost for the session.
Warns if progress.md was not updated this session.

hooks.command: python3 -c "import os,time; p='progress.md'; mtime=os.path.getmtime(p) if os.path.exists(p) else 0; age=time.time()-mtime; print('WARNING: progress.md not updated this session') if age > 3600 else None"
